# Plaza West Laundry

> Self-service laundromat on S Leonard Springs Rd in Bloomington, Indiana. Newer Speed Queen top-loaders, 30 lb Dexter front-loaders and dryers that keep tumbling so nothing wrinkles. Pay by card at every machine, with parking right out front on S Leonard Springs Rd.

- Phone: (812) 825-7368
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Clear Creek, Harrodsburg, Stinesville
- Google rating: 3.8 from 85 reviews

## Services
- Top-load washers: Rows of Speed Queen top-loaders, "the Cadillac of commercial washers" as one regular put it.
- Big front-load washers: Dexter Express 30 lb front-loaders for the big loads: bedding, towels and a week of everything.
- Dryers: A full wall of stacked dryers that keep turning on and off after the cycle ends, so clothes don't wrinkle.
- Card pay & rewards: Swipe a debit or credit card right at the machine, or load a laundry card and earn reward points.
- Soap & supplies: Forgot something? The vending center has detergent, bleach, softener and laundry bags.
- Folding & seating: Long folding tables, red chairs to wait in, outlets on the front wall and a restroom on site.

## About
Plaza West Laundry sits in the white-columned strip plaza on S Leonard Springs Rd, on Bloomington's west side, with parking right in front of the door and the convenience store next door. Inside, it's a classic wood-paneled laundromat with modern machines: rows of Speed Queen top-loaders, Dexter Express 30 lb front-loaders, a full wall of stacked dryers, card readers on every machine, red chairs and long folding tables. It's self-service and open seven days a week, early to late. As one regular put it: if you're serious about getting in and getting out quickly, this is a great place to do your laundry.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Plaza West Laundry is open 7 days a week, 6 AM to 9:30 PM. Start your last wash by 9 PM so it has time to finish.
- Q: Can I pay with a card?
  A: Yes. The washers and dryers take debit and credit cards, and there's a change machine for quarters. When you pay by card, the reader may place a small temporary hold on it that drops off afterward.
- Q: Is there a rewards program?
  A: Yes. Use a laundry card and you earn points as you wash and dry. When you hit the goal, credit is added back to your card.
- Q: What if I have a problem with a machine?
  A: The laundromat is self-service, with no attendant on site. Call (812) 825-7368 or send a message from the contact page, and note the machine number and what happened.
- Q: Can I wash comforters and big loads?
  A: Yes. The Dexter Express 30 lb front-loaders are built for bulky loads like comforters, bedding and big piles of towels.
- Q: Where do I park?
  A: Right in front of the door. The plaza has a large lot at 2910 S Leonard Springs Rd.
